substeps.caption: A beaker of solvent goes in through the 235 mm front opening.
The blower draws air in at the face, about 100 fpm with HEPA and 60 with carbon, through the filters at the back...
...and over to the blower, which returns it to the room: here, into the VLM. Nothing is ducted out.
660 x 610 x 635 mm and 41 kg: it fits a tray, 715 mm with the hose. Carbon takes solvent vapours; acids with HF go to the ducted hood.
